scientific_integrity: An all-size conditional counting proof supports the positionwise law; exact enumeration through size nine is corroborating evidence only.
scientific_limitations: Uniform finite permutations only; cross-family pairwise independence, not full joint independence. Aggregate total-count distribution has published generating-function antecedents. Historical priority of the indexed refinement is not independently certified.
title: Diagonal dependence of record indicators in a uniform permutation and its inverse
